state_profile.voting_summary: North Carolina votes early: 74% of its 2024 vote came from in-person early voting, with mail at 5% after the state ended its postmark grace period (mail now must arrive by election day). Polls close at 7:30 p.m. Eastern; pre-processed early and mail votes are released within the first hour, then election day precincts report, and the state is near-complete by midnight with only provisionals (counted over ~10 days) outstanding. Early voting ran R+3, election day R+13, and mail D+27, so the huge first release sits close to the final margin.
